subject: Eval roadmap and decision gates — proposed POC timeline & owners
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@healthsync.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Eval roadmap and decision gates — proposed POC timeline & owners

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the call earlier today — great to hear more about HealthSync's ingestion patterns and the two high-priority use cases (clinical note normalization + patient-sentiment routing). As discussed, I wanted to put a concise POC proposal on paper so we can align on success criteria, owners, and a lightweight schedule.

Proposal (high level)
- Duration: 4 weeks (kickoff week + 3 validation weeks)
- Success criteria (both MUST be met):
  1) Latency & availability: 95th percentile response under 350ms for normalized-note pipeline at production-like throughput (50 req/s)
  2) Quality: automated end-to-end F1 >= 0.87 against your evaluation set for entity normalization + a manual inspection pass (10 sample reads) without major hallucination failures
- Key milestones: kickoff (week 0), infra & data onboarding complete (end week 1), mid-POC quality checkpoint (end week 2), final readout & decision (end week 3)
- Owners: Redwood technical lead — Vanessa Ortiz; Redwood program lead — me; HealthSync integration lead — Arjun Patel; HealthSync security/compliance — Priya Reddy

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm success criteria above (or flag edits)
2) Sign off on kickoff week: target week of Nov 30 — Dec 4
3) I’ll share a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short infra checklist for you to review prior to kickoff

Attachments: MAP-HealthSync-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (Redwood SOC2 summary)

If that looks good I'll lock the kickoff date and send calendar invites for weekly 30-min checkpoints (Tuesdays, 11am PT).

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@healthsync.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@healthsync.ai>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Eval roadmap and decision gates — proposed POC timeline & owners

Marcus,

Thanks for the summary — this is very helpful and close to what we discussed. A few clarifications and constraints from our side: 

- Security/compliance: we will need Redwood to provide specifics on data retention and an SSO integration plan before kickoff. The SOC2 summary looks good but our InfoSec team may request more detail (e.g., KMS key management).
- Data: we can provide a ~10k-record slice for the initial validation (PHI redacted). Full production-like throughput tests will require a synthetic replay that our infra team will run.
- Decision gate: our procurement requires a brief readout to the PM and CISO after the final week; that's when we decide whether to move to a dedicated reserved capacity trial.

Regarding the proposed dates, the week of Nov 30 works for us for kickoff. Can we add a short security kickoff call (15 minutes) the day before the main technical kickoff? Arjun will coordinate the replay dataset and infra-side contact.

Priya
Director of Data & Integrations | HealthSync
priya.reddy@healthsync.ai | +1 (212) 555-0199

Hi all — quick tech notes and owners from Redwood side:

- Infra checklist (high level) — Attachment: infra-setup-guide.md
  • Network: VPC peering or secure egress; whitelist Redwood IPs for replay traffic
  • Auth: SSO (SAML) + scoped API keys for the trial; recommend short TTL keys during POC
  • Data: sample 10k CSV + schema; provide guidance on PHI redaction steps
  • Load: we'll run staged replay at 10, 25, 50 req/s — start at 10 to validate correctness then ramp to 50 for final latency check

- Redwood owners:
  • Technical onboarding & infra contact: Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com)
  • Runtime performance lead: Sergio Alvarez (sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com)

I'll attach the infra guide and SOC2 appendix in the Drive folder and email the short checklist before the security call.
